subject: Bridging stipend request for internal transfer - temporary compensation proposal
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Bridging stipend request for E. Park (internal transfer to PM)

Hi Olga,

I wanted to flag an exception request for Eliana Park, who will be moving from Eng -> Product on 2027-05-01. Compensation note: her current equity package vests on a calendar schedule that would leave a ~7-month cliff before she achieves the next tranche in Product. The hiring manager and I propose a temporary "bridging stipend" (one-time cash + accelerated partial vesting equivalent) to avoid losing her during the transfer.

Summary (attached calc):
- One-time cash: $18,000
- Accelerated RSU bridge: value equivalent to 0.03% pro-rated (detailed in equity_gap_calc.xlsx)
- Payable on transfer date, with clawback if she leaves < 6 months

As this is outside standard merit cycles and touches equity timing, we need comp + finance signoff and exec acknowledgement. Can you advise next steps and whether this can go to Rishi for comp validation, then Vivek for final approval? I attached the calc and a short memo.

Thanks —
Marissa
Director, Product
Redwood Inference

Attachments: equity_gap_calc.xlsx (spreadsheet), transfer_memo.docx (internal memo)

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-08T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bridging stipend request for E. Park (internal transfer to PM)

Thanks Marissa —

Quick clarifying Qs before I kick to Rishi:
1) Is the $18k proposed from recruiting / retention budget or from Product headcount budget? Who signs the final PO?
2) For the RSU-equivalent, is this a true grant or a cash equivalent? If grant, we need equity committee routing and Mercer confirmation.
3) Proposed clawback language — please paste the exact sentence you want in the offer amendment so legal can review.

If you can confirm by EOD I will prepare a short approval packet for Rishi + Vivek.

- Olga
Head, Total Rewards (acting)
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-09T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bridging stipend request for E. Park (internal transfer to PM)

On Thu, Apr 8, 2027 at 10:03 AM Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick clarifying Qs before I kick to Rishi:
> 1) Is the $18k proposed from recruiting / retention budget or from Product headcount budget? Who signs the final PO?
> 2) For the RSU-equivalent, is this a true grant or a cash equivalent? If grant, we need equity committee routing and Mercer confirmation.
> 3) Proposed clawback language — please paste the exact sentence you want in the offer amendment so legal can review.

Hi all — reviewed the calc and draft memo. High level: I support a bridging allowance in principle for transfers that would otherwise create retention risk. A few items for the packet before I can approve:
- Confirm funding source: Marissa flagged Product budget; if Product bears cost we skip recruiting retention pool approval. Please confirm budget owner.
- RSU vs cash: prefer cash-equivalent payment for speed; if team wants RSU we route to equity committee which will add ~2w processing.
- Clawback: suggested text below. Legal can iterate.

Suggested clawback sentence to include in amendment:
"The Bridging Stipend (cash or equity-equivalent) will be subject to a 6-month service clawback: if the employee terminates employment for any reason within six months of the transfer effective date, Redwood reserves the right to recoup the stipend on a prorated basis."

If Marissa confirms budget owner and whether cash-equivalent is acceptable, I can sign off on comp economics and pass to Vivek for alignment on exceptions / precedent.

-Rishi
VP, Compensation

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bridging stipend request for E. Park (internal transfer to PM)

Thanks Rishi — quick answers:
- Funding: Product is taking the cost; PO will be internal charge to "Product — 2027 Q2". I confirmed with finance on a quick check and they said internal charge is fine but they prefer cash payment over RSU to avoid equity committee delays.
- We accept the clawback language as written.

I've attached a short bridging_stipend_form.pdf that includes budget code and signoff lines for finance. If you and Olga are OK with the cash-equivalent route, please mark approved and I will route to Vivek for final sign-off.

On another note, Eliana is aware this is an exception request and would sign the amendment. We don't expect public precedent — will handle as an isolated internal transfer exception.

Cheers,
Marissa

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T15:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bridging stipend request for E. Park (internal transfer to PM)

Thanks everyone for the packet and quick turnaround. I reviewed the numbers and the proposed clawback. I approve the one-time cash bridging stipend of $18,000, plus the cash-equivalent RSU payout as documented, funded by Product. Conditions:
- Document the payment in an offer amendment and have the employee sign the clawback language.
- Finance to process as internal charge (Product — 2027 Q2).
- Legal to sign off on the amendment before payment.

Olga/Rishi — please route the amendment through DocuSign and copy me on the envelope. Once it's signed, Finance can process the payment.

-Vivek
